description:
Anglia Ruskin University is among the top 350 institutions globally and has been named one of the top 40 universities in the UK. Welcoming students from 185 different countries, the university is known for its multicultural community. One of its campuses is in Cambridge, and the other is in Chelmsford.

Anglia Ruskin has recently invested £100 million in its facilities. It has nine optometry faculties in the UK and the Ruskin Gallery, a public art gallery. It also has a brand new Science Center, a Law School Clinic, courtrooms for rehearsals, video game rooms, and 24/7 libraries with numerous books and online learning resources.

The University stands out with the various support services it provides in different fields. These include special services for students with disabilities, such as assistance with mental and physical health conditions and learning difficulties. Counseling and the friendly Foreign Student Center, which strives for international students, are among other support services.

Students can benefit from invaluable career services while studying at Anglia Ruskin. The Employment Service offers students assistance with a variety of subjects, from preparing a resume to interviews. Many valuable resources are available online, as well as one-on-one sessions with counselors.

Angela Ruskin students can be part of social clubs and societies in their spare time. Through these groups, they can make new friends, learn new skills, and gain unique experiences for their resumes. Clubs and societies range from dance classes to alternative music ensembles.
